questions.question: Devahuti is described as the mother of Lord Kapila and the wife of whom?
questions.explanation: "Thus Devahuti, the mother of Lord Kapila and wife of Kardama Muni, became freed from all ignorance concerning devotional service and transcendental knowledge." (SB 3.33.1)

questions.question: Lord Kapila is called the author of the basic principles of which system of philosophy, described as the background of liberation?
questions.explanation: "She offered her obeisances unto the Lord, the author of the basic principles of the Sankhya system of philosophy, which is the background of liberation." (SB 3.33.1)

questions.question: According to Devahuti's prayer, why is Brahma said to be unborn?

options.text: Because he takes birth from the lotus flower growing from the Lord's abdomen
Because he meditated for a million years

questions.explanation: "Brahma is said to be unborn because he takes birth from the lotus flower which grows from Your abdomen while You lie in the ocean at the bottom of the universe." (SB 3.33.2)

questions.question: Devahuti marvels that at the end of the millennium the Lord lies down on a leaf of what tree, licking the toe of His lotus foot like a baby?
questions.explanation: "At the end of the millennium You lie down on a leaf of a banyan tree, and just like a small baby, You lick the toe of Your lotus foot." (SB 3.33.4)

questions.question: According to Devahuti, even a person born in a family of dog-eaters becomes eligible to perform Vedic sacrifices if he once does what?

options.text: Utters the holy name of the Supreme Personality of Godhead

questions.explanation: "Even a person born in a family of dog-eaters immediately becomes eligible to perform Vedic sacrifices if he once utters the holy name of the Supreme Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.33.6)

questions.question: Devahuti declares that the Lord is Lord Visnu Himself under the name of Kapila, and at the time of dissolution all of what are sustained in Him only?
questions.explanation: "At the time of dissolution, all the Vedas are sustained in You only." (SB 3.33.8)

questions.question: Lord Kapila tells his mother that by following the path of self-realization He instructed, she shall be liberated when?
questions.explanation: "You can execute this system without difficulty, and by following it you shall very soon be liberated, even within your present body." (SB 3.33.10)

questions.question: After instructing his beloved mother and taking permission from her, what did Lord Kapila do?

options.text: He left His home, His mission having been fulfilled

questions.explanation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead Kapila, after instructing His beloved mother, took permission from her and left His home, His mission having been fulfilled." (SB 3.33.12)

questions.question: In whose house, decorated with flowers as the flower crown of the river Sarasvati, did Devahuti practice samadhi?
questions.explanation: "She practiced samadhi in the house of Kardama Muni, which was so beautifully decorated with flowers that it was considered the flower crown of the river Sarasvati." (SB 3.33.13)

questions.question: The opulence of the household of Kardama Muni was sometimes envied by whom?

options.text: Those who travel in outer space in airplanes

questions.explanation: "His opulence was sometimes envied by those who travel in outer space in airplanes." (SB 3.33.15)

questions.question: When Devahuti would enter the lovely garden to bathe in the lotus pond, who would sing about Kardama's glorious household life?
questions.explanation: "The associates of the denizens of heaven, the Gandharvas, would sing about Kardama's glorious household life." (SB 3.33.19)

questions.question: Despite all her possessions envied even by the ladies of heaven, what was Devahuti only sorry about?

options.text: That her great son was separated from her

questions.explanation: "She was only sorry that her great son was separated from her." (SB 3.33.20)

questions.question: Devahuti's grief at the loss of her son Kapila is compared to what?

options.text: A cow affected when her calf dies

questions.explanation: "She was very aggrieved at the loss of her son, just as a cow is affected when her calf dies." (SB 3.33.21)

questions.question: By following the principles instructed by Kapila, Devahuti soon became liberated and achieved the Supreme Personality of Godhead in which aspect?
questions.explanation: "Devahuti soon became liberated from material bondage and achieved the Supreme Personality of Godhead, as Supersoul, without difficulty." (SB 3.33.30)

questions.question: The most sacred spot where Devahuti achieved her perfection is known all over the three worlds by what name?
questions.explanation: "It is known all over the three worlds as Siddhapada." (SB 3.33.31)

questions.question: After leaving His father's hermitage with His mother's permission, in which direction did the great sage Kapila go?
questions.explanation: "The great sage Kapila, the Personality of Godhead, left His father's hermitage with the permission of His mother and went towards the northeast." (SB 3.33.33)

questions.question: When Kapila passed in the northern direction, who offered Him oblations and a place of residence?
questions.explanation: "The ocean offered Him oblations and a place of residence." (SB 3.33.34)

questions.question: Anyone who hears or reads the narration of Kapiladeva and His mother becomes a devotee of the Lord, who is carried by whom?
questions.explanation: "Anyone who hears or reads this narration becomes a devotee of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is carried by Garuda." (SB 3.33.37)

questions.question: ______ is also called as 'Aja'.
Bhakthi Rasaamrata Sindhu is written by ______.
Hari Bhakthi Vilasa is written by ______.
______ is so perfect that simply by following the rules and regulations and executing them under direction of Spiritual Master, one is liberated from clutches of Maya.
The actual identity of the living entity as described by Lord Chaitanya is "Jivera svarapa haya – krsnera nitya dasa" – this means ______.

options.text: Living entity is merged with the Supreme Lord
Jivas are always independent and do not need Krishna
Living entity is eternally the servitor of the Supreme Lord

questions.question: Devahuti's father's name is ______, son's name is ______, husband's name is ______.

options.text: Svaayambhuva Manu, Kapila Dev, Kardama Muni
Kardama Muni, Kapila Dev, Svaayambhuva Manu
Kapila Dev, Svaayambhuva Manu, Kardama Muni
Kapila Dev, Kardama Muni, Svaayambhuva Manu
